$schema: Type roles replace ad-hoc fontSize literals. Sizes derived from the current app's fontSize histogram (12, 11, 13, 10, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 26). Space Grotesk ships as four FAMILIES, not weights: the kit resolves a weight to a family and strips fontWeight so no platform synthesises a second bold.

family.$description: The four Space Grotesk faces by their PostScript names (SpaceGrotesk-Regular …). iOS resolves a fontFamily by PostScript name and Android by the file name under assets/fonts, so the bundled TTFs are named the same way; the old expo-font keys (SpaceGrotesk_400Regular) were registration aliases, not font names.

weightToFamily.$description: Thresholds from the current Text.tsx: <450 regular, <550 medium, <650 semibold, else bold.

maxFontScale.$description: Trading controls have fixed heights; NIFTY2026090823900PE cannot wrap. 1.3 honours the smaller accessibility steps; money values clamp lower.
